evals.prompt: 我在本地跑了一个 OpenAI 兼容的模型服务（http://127.0.0.1:20129/v1，镜像 OpenRouter 返回结构），想把它加进 EasyResearch 的 models.json（provider 名 myapi），主要用 deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731 这个推理模型。请生成该模型的完整 models.json 条目。不要改动任何真实配置文件，把结果写到输出目录。
evals.expected_output: models.json 条目，值（contextWindow/maxTokens/reasoning/input）与 API 实际一致，即 agent 主动探测了端点

evals.prompt: 帮我添加 google/gemini-flash-2 到 EasyResearch 的 models.json（provider 名 myapi，服务地址 http://127.0.0.1:20129/v1，OpenRouter 结构），它支持图像输入但不支持推理。请给出 models.json 条目。不要改动任何真实配置文件，把结果写到输出目录。
evals.expected_output: models.json 条目，contextWindow/maxTokens 与 API 实际一致（agent 主动探测），input=["text","image"]，无 reasoning 字段

evals.prompt: 我要在 EasyResearch 的 models.json 里添加 deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731（provider myapi，API 见 http://127.0.0.1:20129/v1/models，OpenRouter 返回结构）。请给出完整 models.json 条目：为它设计 thinkingLevelMap，并处理它 deepseek 风格的 thinkingFormat。不要改动任何真实配置文件，把结果写到输出目录。
evals.expected_output: 条目含探测值 contextWindow=1048576/maxTokens=393216，thinkingLevelMap 覆盖 supported_efforts 的 low/high/max，含 compat.thinkingFormat

evals.prompt: 只调整当前项目的 EasyResearch API 请求配置：请求超时改为 10 分钟，临时错误最多额外重试 2 次，不增加 Provider 内层重试。现有全局 settings.json 为 {"retry":{"enabled":true,"maxRetries":4,"baseDelayMs":1000,"provider":{"maxRetries":0,"maxRetryDelayMs":45000}},"easyresearch":{"web":{"showApiUsageDetails":false}}}，项目 settings.json 为 {"extensions":["./local-extension.ts"],"customFlag":"keep"}。给出最小修改后的项目 JSON、合并后的 retry、配置生效步骤和超时边界。只输出，不读取或修改真实配置。
evals.expected_output: Project settings preserve extensions/customFlag and use native retry.maxRetries=2 and retry.provider.timeoutMs=600000. Effective retry preserves inherited enabled/baseDelayMs/provider.maxRetries/maxRetryDelayMs. No global or Agent-default mutation. Explains additional retries, runtime recreation, and provider-dependent timeout rather than a whole-task deadline.
assertions: The project JSON preserves existing fields and only overrides the requested native retry fields; it does not move them into easyresearch or models.json.
The effective retry preserves the supplied global nested values while applying the requested timeout and additional retry count.
The answer distinguishes saving from recreating a runtime and does not claim an exact whole-task deadline or universal provider support.

evals.prompt: EasyResearch 的 Pi 0.84.3 模板里 timeoutMs 是 3600000，这是不是默认所有 API 都会等待一小时？我想无限等待，把 retry.provider.timeoutMs、httpIdleTimeoutMs、websocketConnectTimeoutMs、retry.provider.maxRetryDelayMs 和 easyresearch.web.sessionIdleTimeoutMs 全设成 0 可以吗？另外把 retry.enabled=false 后是否连 Provider 内层重试也关掉了？请解释默认值、每个 0 的含义，以及 OpenAI/Anthropic、Codex、Google/Vertex、Bedrock 的支持边界。不要修改任何文件。
evals.expected_output: Rejects one-hour-as-default and all-zero-as-unlimited assumptions. Describes AgentSession timeout fallback to httpIdleTimeoutMs, provider-specific zero behavior, HTTP and WebSocket timer scope, maxRetryDelayMs=0 removing the wait cap, sessionIdleTimeoutMs=0 immediately disconnecting only when idle versus -1 disabling expiry, and independent retry layers. Does not promise universal stream deadlines or unsupported provider controls.
assertions: The one-hour example is distinguished from the ordinary SDK fallback, and retry.provider.timeoutMs=0 is not recommended as a portable unlimited timeout.
Zero-valued HTTP/WebSocket timers, server backoff cap, and Web idle retention are explained separately; never-expiring Web retention uses -1.
Disabling agent retries is not claimed to disable provider retries, transport recovery, or all network attempts.
Provider limitations distinguish OpenAI/Anthropic request versus stream timing, Codex timing, and unsupported Google/Vertex/Bedrock timeout wiring.

evals.prompt: 给我 EasyResearch 的常用配置片段，不要实际写文件：所有项目在上下文占用 60% 时自动压缩，当前项目保留最近 12000 token、禁止向模型发送图片，并为支持数字思考预算的模型设置 high=8192。我还想在代理不支持 WebSocket 时用 SSE。请区分全局和项目文件，保留没有要求修改的配置；说明这些数字是不是默认值、压缩保留量是否保证、思考预算能否套用所有模型、SSE 是否改变 Web UI 连接，以及何时生效。
evals.expected_output: Separates global easyresearch.compaction.triggerPercent=60 from native project compaction.keepRecentTokens=12000, images.blockImages=true, thinkingBudgets.high=8192, and transport=sse. Does not override unrelated settings or Agent thinking selection. Explains model-aware retention cap, provider-dependent numeric thinking support, image-content removal, LLM transport scope, selected values versus defaults, and setting-specific application timing.
assertions: The global percentage and native project fields are placed in separate settings fragments without changing unrelated fields or Agent defaults.
The answer explains the keepRecentTokens ceiling and distinguishes high-token budget from model thinking-level selection and universal provider support.
The answer does not require a top-level thinking-token-budget compatibility flag for every OpenAI-compatible model or claim high budgets can never affect extended levels.
Image blocking is described as preventing image content from reaching the model, and transport=sse is scoped to supporting LLM providers rather than browser SSE.
Requested example values are not called product defaults, and general settings are not promised universal hot reload.
